description: This file defines the OpenClawChatViewModel class, which manages state and interactions for a chat UI in a client application utilizing OpenClaw's chat transport. It handles message history, session management, sending and aborting messages, model and session selection, handling transport events, attachment management, and health checks.

classes.name: OpenClawChatViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class managing the state, logic, and interactions of an OpenClaw chat UI, including message handling, session management, model selection, and transport event processing.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initializes the chat session by loading initial data and setting up event streams.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the chat state by re-initializing data from the transport.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the current input as a message in the chat session.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the latest list of chat sessions from the server.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches the active chat session to the specified session key.

methods.name: selectThinkingLevel
methods.description: Sets the thinking level for the session.

methods.name: selectModel
methods.description: Selects a specific model for the chat session.
